extraction.Name: Baptiste Jones
extraction.Recorded patent: Filed for record, Noble County, Okla.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Land mortgaged to Red Rock State Bank and Albright Title & Trust Co. for $7400.00; Sold to Hoy Hess for $9500 and he to assume mortgages
extraction.Buyer: Hoy Hess of Ponca City, Ok. for $9500 (he to assume mortgages); mortgaged to Red Rock State Bank and Albright Title & Trust Co. for $7400.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: Has any of the land been sold for debt or taxes? no
extraction.Occupation/Income: $20.00 per year income from inherited land and no contributions of any kind
extraction.NOTES: Good health, no property or money accumulated; wife and one minor child dependent; patent delivered at Otoe Agency and receipted for; date of redemption expired yes; at the time the allottee sold the land he says that he did not owe mortgages or notes to the amount of $9500.00 — when he sold the land to Mr. Hess, he was required to deduct a loan of $500 which made the consideration $9500.00 but that after mortgages were paid, he received no money; notarized November 23, 1928, Kay County, Oklahoma; file no. 61391; mortgage when: 1917 or 1918
